design.grouping: one question per emitted formula, per fitted coefficient vector, or per set of replicates of one quantity
design.provenance: every row names its file and JSON pointer
design.bounded_ladder: the reduction stops at 27 digits on purpose: past the input precision it starts returning exact relations among 52-bit rationals
design.not_a_claim_of_structure: finding a relation in a group says those emitted numbers have one; it does not say the discovery was right about the world
design.skipped_groups: groups beyond max_groups are counted, never sampled silently
